stations.name: Protected sample intake and inspection
stations.boundary: Room-temperature, ESD-managed and outside any magnet hazard zone
stations.inputs: Sealed or protected chip carrier; non-contact identity/condition observation
stations.required_receipts: Carrier ID, occupancy, condition photos, handling authorization
stations.prohibition: No bare-chip grasp or probe contact unless separately qualified

stations.name: Qualified external fabrication and preparation service
stations.boundary: All microfabrication, chemicals, hot processing, e-beam, plasma and vacuum operations remain with named specialist service
stations.required_receipts: Process-history/release receipt and safely packaged chip
stations.prohibition: No robot-executable synthesis, etch, solvent, anneal or deposition recipe

stations.name: Closed cryogenic magnet measurement service
stations.boundary: All cryostat, condensed-helium, pressure/vacuum, strong-field and quench operations held by specialist operator
stations.inputs: Accepted protected carrier and approved measurement request
stations.required_receipts: Sample mount ID, condition/state observations, run permit and result bundle
stations.prohibition: Robot does not enter field exclusion zone, insert/remove cold sample, open vacuum/cryogen circuit or operate magnet

stations.name: Qualified electrical characterization service
stations.boundary: Interlocked low-noise source/nanovoltmeter path owned by specialist
stations.inputs: Mounted identity, approved terminal map and condition list
stations.required_receipts: Raw Rxx/Rxy/contact/transition evidence with calibration/noise flags
stations.prohibition: No automatic range/current escalation; shared hardware with ST03 is possible and requires one lease

stations.name: Qualified precision CCC service
stations.boundary: Calibrated bridge, protected connections, polarity reversal and timing managed by specialist
stations.inputs: Accepted comparisons with explicit reference/test roles and qualified operating envelope
stations.required_receipts: Raw ratio/cycle/time/SD series, bridge settings, field/temperature logs
stations.prohibition: No energized rewire, unlocked winding switch or source-specified current as a safety limit

stations.name: Controlled reference-resistor services
stations.boundary: Separate 100-ohm oil-bath and 12.9-kiloohm air-bath identities, each with qualified thermal/power limits
stations.inputs: Calibrated reference identity and approved load/measurement configuration
stations.required_receipts: Bath stability, resistor current, temperature and drift/calibration receipt
stations.prohibition: Same bath cabinet artwork must never merge the two distinct thermal services

stations.name: Read-only evidence and analysis workstation
stations.boundary: No physical control path; uses qualified evidence schema
stations.inputs: Immutable run bundles and approved analysis method
stations.required_receipts: Derived results with uncertainty/covariance, provenance and exceptions
stations.prohibition: Eq 3/Eq 4/loop implementation held pending qualification; no fabricated or source-digitized raw observations

stations.name: Safe return, supported hold and quarantine
stations.boundary: Accepted carrier support and approved storage outside active hazard zones
stations.inputs: Independent warm/field/pressure/electrical/motion safe evidence and sample condition
stations.required_receipts: Final custody acceptance, location and complete/partial/failed/unattempted state
stations.prohibition: A stop request, timer, display icon or source-current zero command is not safe-state proof

lease_rule: One owner per physical sample and shared instrument; software station labels do not authorize simultaneous use of one cryostat/CCC. Distinct service names may be logical roles on the same equipment.
